clips.title: The story
paras: Hive'Zora is one of the three major silithid colony mounds dominating the arid expanse of Silithus. Located along the western edge of the desert, this teeming subterranean hive crawls with aggressive insectoid castes serving the greater swarm.

Rising out of the barren sand dunes of western Silithus, Hive'Zora serves as a bustling hub of insectoid activity. Great, porous stone spires and mounds mark the entrances into deep subterranean tunnels dug out by silithid burrowers. Waywatchers and reavers patrol the perimeter relentlessly, while tunneling castes and hive sisters brood within the depths below. For the Cenarion Circle and other scouts keeping watch over the desert, the hive represents a terrifying sign of the insectoid menace steadily reclaiming the ancient frontier.
